info.title: Rahul Raj — Portfolio & Systems Architecture API
info.description:
Production-grade RESTful API documentation for Rahul Raj's modern portfolio platform, built with **Next.js 16**, **TypeScript**, **MongoDB Atlas**, **Cloudinary**, and **AI LLM Orchestration**.

### Key Architectural Pillars
- **Public Gateway**: Ultra-fast endpoints for portfolio contents, live ATS resume downloads, real-time presence heartbeats, and AI assistant interaction.
- **Admin Control Studio & Hardware Biometrics**: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) secured via WebAuthn/FIDO2 hardware biometric passkeys (Fingerprint, TouchID, Windows Hello, FaceID), 4-digit security PIN, master passcode, cryptographic HMAC tokens, or Email OTP resets.
- **Resilience Engine**: Zero-crash persistence architecture backed by MongoDB Atlas with in-memory caching and real-time health telemetry probes.
- **Security & Anti-Abuse**: IP-based sliding window rate limiters, anti-bot honeypot traps, and encrypted session cookies.
